description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a fragment in an Android application that displays log messages using a LogView component inside a ScrollView. It handles view inflation, layout setup, and updates the scroll position when log text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that manages a log display for app debugging, containing a LogView inside a ScrollView. It provides a method to get the LogView instance.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and initializes the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, appearance, and padding, then returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's main view, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on log updates, and returns the view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
